title: That night at Dalkey the train had roared like that and then, when it went into the tunnel, the roar stopped.
html_source: Actually in reality this is exactly opposite: the noise of the running train immensely increases when it gets INTO the tunnel (sort of effect of being in a closed drum or pot is created) and decreases when it gets OUT OF it into an open area. ;-)
